meta.title: Goshogawara City Kase Ski Area
meta.description: A completely free local ski hill within walking distance of Kase Station on the Tsugaru Railway—your gateway to Kanagi onsen, comfort food, and deep Tsugaru winter culture.

transit.title:
Hop off the Stove Train,
then walk to snow.
transit.lead: Kase is one of the rare small ski hills you can realistically pair with a local railway stop. The hill is tiny and simple, but its free entry and closeness to Kanagi's food, onsen, and cultural stops make it a strong deep-local winter detour.
specs: ~15 min by car from Goshogawara-kita IC
transit.imgAlt: Winter approach from Kase Station on the Tsugaru Railway toward Goshogawara City Kase Ski Area

primary.title: Free entry × railway nostalgia
primary.lead: Kase cannot compete with commercial resorts on scale. Its advantage is different: completely free access and a story-rich position near the Tsugaru Railway. It feels less like a resort and more like stepping into everyday winter life in rural Tsugaru.
primary.imgAlt: Local snow scene at Goshogawara City Kase Ski Area

secondary.title: A snow gateway feeding the Kanagi loop
secondary.lead: The value is not in lift-ticket revenue. It is in sending people onward—to Kanagi Onsen, Poppo-ya, Shayokan, and the Tsugaru Shamisen Hall—after their first snow touch or quick local run.

pass.title:
¥0 to enter,
more room to explore.
pass.lead: Because the hill is free, visitors can shift budget toward sled rentals, onsen baths, local meals, and cultural stops in Kanagi. That is the real value proposition: use the hill as a winter entry point, not as a standalone paid resort.
specs: Season usually early Jan to late Feb
pass.noticeBody: Any paid rentals or sales tied directly to the hill need public-property permission. In practice, station pickup, partner shops, and nearby tourism businesses are the cleanest first step.
pass.imgAlt: A local winter trip built around the Tsugaru Railway and Kanagi area

rental.title:
Make snow play easy,
through the town.
rental.lead: The hill itself has limited rental infrastructure, so the better model is a town-wide one: pre-book sleds, snowshoes, and kid-friendly snow gear through Kanagi partners, then collect them near the station or local lodging.
rental.whisper: Even a tiny free hill can feel visitor-ready when booking and handoff are handled by the wider area rather than the slope alone.
rental.imgAlt: Hands-free snow-play concept linked to Kase Station and the Kanagi area

yukinko.title:
A small lit hill,
quiet Tsugaru at night.
yukinko.lead: With about 10 lighting units and evening hours on weekdays, Kase can offer a different kind of winter night—less resort energy, more intimate local atmosphere for children, residents, and curious travelers.
yukinko.whisper: Link it with Kanagi Onsen and local dinners, and even a short evening visit becomes a full winter experience.
yukinko.imgAlt: Evening snow scene at Goshogawara City Kase Ski Area under local night lighting

family.title:
First snow,
without the pressure.
family.lead: There is no long resort-style terrain here, but that is exactly why Kase works for families and first-timers. The scale is small, the barrier is low, and visitors can focus on snow touch, sledding, and simple first runs.
specs: Good for sleds and first steps
Local jump and XC culture nearby
family.noticeBody: The Anver lift behaves more like a rope/surface system and may be awkward for snowboarders or very small kids. For many visitors, snow play is the best-fit way to enjoy the hill.
family.imgAlt: Family snow play and first snow experience at Goshogawara City Kase Ski Area

workation.title:
Snow at Kase,
then Kanagi culture and baths.
workation.lead: Kase is best treated as part of a half-day or full-day Tsugaru loop: Tsugaru Railway, free snow play, Shayokan, shamisen culture, onsen, and local comfort food. The hill is the start of the story, not the whole story.

local.title: Tsugaru Railway × free hill guide
local.body: The core edit is to frame Kase not as a competitor to larger resorts, but as an ultra-local snow gateway linked to station access and the Kanagi area’s onsen, food, and culture.

schools.title: Unstaffed-station digital stamp loop
schools.body: Connect Kase Station, the hill, and Kanagi partner businesses through a smartphone stamp rally with etiquette tips and local offers. It is a practical way to turn unstaffed infrastructure into measurable circulation.

summer.title: Deep Tsugaru Snow Stop
summer.body: For travelers who want local rail, snow, diners, and baths—not just big-resort mileage. Kase works best as a gentle first snow touch inside a richer Tsugaru winter story.
